entities.name: Juan de Tassis, 1st Count of Villamediana

entities.summary: Juan de Tassis y Acuña, 1st Count of Villamediana, was a Spanish diplomat and official, awarded his title by king Philip III of Spain in 1603, and the General Head of Spanish Post Offices.
